page.content:
Half-elf ranger-rogue of Vox Machina, twin of Vax, later Baroness of the Third House.

How Vex'ahlia connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Vex'ahlia is the ranger of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Laura Bailey — Laura Bailey plays Vex'ahlia.
  • Character: Vax'ildan — Vex'ahlia and Vax'ildan are twins in Vox Machina.
  • Character: Percival de Rolo — Vex later marries Percy and rules Whitestone with him.

What is Vex'ahlia?

Vex'ahlia is Laura Bailey's Campaign 1 ranger, twin of Vax'ildan, Trinket's companion, and later Lady Vex'ahlia de Rolo of Whitestone.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina, Laura Bailey, Vax'ildan and Percival de Rolo.
